# Suggested locale-search coverage steering (root owns integration/spec edits).
# 02705648/027058CC name and all suffix/tail SafeStrings use 8-byte objects.
# Their virtual refresh lives in vtable+0x14, takes r3=8, and may update mpBuffer.
# 027060BC LayoutLocale_assureString takes r3=8 and is a mocked call, not reimplemented.
# 02705554 suffixForIndex accepts s32 index and returns const be<u8>*.
# Name and suffix fixtures: empty, "abc", "abc_JPja", "abc_USen", "abc_USen_more",
# repeated suffixes, same-buffer aliases, mismatch at byte0 and later byte.
# suffix result lengths zero, shorter than name, same size, longer than name.
# 02705640 count: 0,1,2,13; 02705638 expected suffix length: 0,1,5,6.
# 02705B94 root: full pane view >=0x81 (name at0x80, vtable0x08, list0x14).
# Initialize child-list sentinel root+0x14 or bounded chains; null root still reads0x14
# on fallback, exactly as original (do not assume early null return).
# Pane RTTI getter at vtable+0x14 returns 0,101FD8F8 (matching Pane), or chain
# ending at101FD8F8, or a nonmatching chain ending0. Mock return matching RTTI
# is needed to reach suffix and name comparisons.
# Guards101FD89C,101FD888 initialized/uninitialized; singleton node101FD8F8,
# root node101FD8FC; RTTI singleton02704C24 adds101FDD40,101FD8F0 guards and
# nodes101FDD3C,101FD8F4. All16 guard combinations exercise lazy init paths.
# Recursive findPane call remains mocked; force null/non-null to test sibling loop.
